_comment: Shipped patterns. Add and remove from the Watch button in the room; that writes ~/.live-room/watch.json as plain words, not patterns. A pattern here that does not compile is skipped. Launch detection is not here, because a loose pattern would invent who started whom.

needsYou.action: \b(log ?in|sign ?in|authenticat\w*|authori[sz]e\w*|verification code|2fa|captcha|on your end|manually|you(?:'ll| will)? need to|need(?:s)? you to|i can(?:'|no)t|i'm unable|i am unable|paste (?:it|the|your)|enter your)\b
needsYou.decide: \?\s*$|\b(should i|shall i|want me to|do you want me|would you like me|let me know (?:which|if|whether|what)|your call)\b
